question: Related Questions Q. I have senn in dreams a family of jinns in my house, they are of very friendly nature with me and they dont disturb me. 2350 views Q. I sawn this dream. I am looking for tabir. Please answer me as quick as possible. I saw as follow: I was standing outside Jamiah Islamiah Dabhel and facing towards the road that goes towards Dabhel village. I saw Daura Hadith Building of Darul Uloom Deoband next to it. as I saw it I started giving Azan facing Daura Hadith Building of Darul Uloom Deoband. as I was giving Azan I saw two men coming in a car and getting out. They gave me salaam. I thought in my heart how can they give me salaam while I am giving Azan. Then I saw I am standing by frontdoor of my house in England and looking towards Daura Hadith Building of Darul Uloom Deoband. I can see it infront of my house and my family members are talking inside. As I was loooking my sister came and called me. Please give me tabir as I am a bit worried about it. JazakAllah. 2150 views Q. As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. Can you please tell me what this means? May Allah SWT reward you for your time and effort. 1610 views Q. Assalamu alaikum, i would like to know the meaning of a dream that a friend of mine had. recently her mother passed away, after her mother passed away close friends and relatives told her often that they see her mother in their dreams. after hearing this from her friends she prayed to Allah asking Allah that she wants to see her mother in her dream.That night she had a dream about her mother, in the dream she saw that her mother was buried, but family members and other people had to get her out becuase she was going to have a baby, after her mother was brought out, her mother was taken to the hospital to have her baby, theN she saw that she was running to see her mother, but she was told by doctors that her mother was in the hospital basement, so she ran to the basement but when she got there she saw her mother in a bag the way she was when she first died. My friend would like to know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallah 2192 views Q. Dream 1439 views Q. I want to know that the gift sent by bride father as a Eid Teohari (like dry fruits, sewayi etc) exist some sunnat with this. Is it okay to send teohari? 1837 views Q. Assalamualiku,..i have seen lots of time in my dreams that i am in examination centre.& i do not know the answer of the question..some times i reach late to examination centre & i missed my exams...some times i am appearing in the exam & have feelings that i will be failed in this exam..presently i am employed in saudi arabia..my academic record was not good..always i managed just paasing marks..such dreams related to exams i have seen lots of time..pls tell me the tabir of my dreams...jazakallah khera for your services. 1589 views Q. Mufti Sb. Asslam-alaikum bad salam arj karna hai ki Aaj Kal Shadi ke Kardo par Allah ka Nam, 786 aur bissmillah sharif likha ja raha hai.Shadi ke bad en kardo ko log kabadi ko bench dete hai ya kudi vegra par dal dete hai. Barai meharbani es masle par deen kee roshni dale. 1769 views Q. میری بیوی نے خواب دیکھا کہ اس کا انتقال ہوگیاہے، اور اس کا جنازہ ہے، اور لوگ رو رہے ہیں۔ گذشتہ دس رات سے وہ یہ خواب دیکھ رہی ہے۔ براہ کرم، تعبیر بتائیں۔ 1474 views Q. I hope you are well and happy. My mother had done istikhara for many days for my sister regarding marriage. 1. These are the dreams my mother had: 1.She is going inside a shop and selecting Comforter(huge thick blanket). She selecting one comforter, she says: ''This comforter is 100% allright but from this I have to select 1,2,3." A little background of the potential husband: He has two brothers, one elder to him and one younger to him. 2.She sees fire(about the height of man) burning. In a corner she sees an unknown girl standing. My mother's second brother that is my Uncle Nazeer puts off the fire! Then she is breastfeeding an infant and the infant refuses to drink. 3.She is breastfeeding an infant and only a drop goes inside the infant's mouth and it spits out and my mother's whole face gets covered with milk. 4. She is standing on some platform little above the ground, a lady brings fresh milk in a bottle. My mother says: "I cant get down, please go and keep it in refrigerator." 5. She saw some crows. She recognises one crow as a male. She then wonders" How was I able to differentiate between a male and femal crow? Before I was not able to recognise a male crow or a female crow". These are the dreams my mother had. Dear Mufti, my mother is confused as to what to do. Please tell me the taabeer of dreams. 1677 views Q. I have few srilankan friends, met them in tabliq marqaz. I saw in my dream [close to Fajar waqth] two of my srilankan friends came in my dream gave three Moons to me. [i.e, 3 white color circle items with excellent bright in a plate]. Can you please interpret this dream. May Allah accept us in his loved once. Massalam 1452 views Q. I have asked this question before, but you did not answer, Kindly answer this time. I am engaged to a girl who is my cousin and my marriage is going to happen very soon, I wanted to know the interpretation of my dream- " In the dream, I am saying to my parents that i don't want to marry her, later on her parents also come to know about my intension, but after some time i again regret my decision and tell my parents that i made a mistake, i want to marry the same girl(ie., my cousin)".. please give the meaning of this dream, i was very worried after seeing this kind of dream, because i liked this girl and told my parents of my intention, everything is of my choice and will only, but seeing this kind of dream is making me worried. 1408 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 9083 Country: Bangladesh Title: Mufti Shaheb, Somebody (male) has touched the private body parts of another person(male) intentionally. Is just making Tawba is enough for him, or he has to seek forgiveness from the second person? Jazakallah Question: Mufti Shaheb, Somebody (male) has touched the private body parts of another person(male) intentionally. Is just making Tawba is enough for him, or he has to seek forgiveness from the second person? Jazakallah Answer ID: 9083 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1157/1157=M/1429) It is sufficient to repent to Allah. If that person felt some resentment or he was hurt then one should apologized to him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
